name: security-audit
description: Audits Compact circuits for witness disclosure violations, double-spend risks, and error 186 patterns. Blocks commits that violate ADR-001 or reintroduce shared-pool UTXO logic. Uses ruflo-security-audit skill and CVE scanning.
audit_checks: Scan for witness variables passed directly into sendShielded without disclose()
Detect shared pool UTXO patterns (single batchCoin used by multiple recipients)
Verify Map<RecipientKey, ShieldedCoinInfo> usage matches ADR-001
Check all public contract functions for witness-value disclosure risk
Flag any mt_index usage that does not fetch from latest indexer state
constraints: Block any circuit change that reintroduces pool UTXO sharing
Require explicit disclose() audit trail for all witness fields
Report findings to tesseract namespace memory before approving
